sentences.text: Researchers investigated whether the loss of the TDP-43 protein disrupts neuronal communication at synapses.
To test this, the team used a specific genetic tool to correct a splicing error in the UNC13A gene within human neurons and a humanized mouse model.
The authors suggest this approach could be a viable treatment for the vast majority of patients with ALS and about half of those with frontotemporal dementia who have TDP-43 issues.
